title: Data Protection Expert Member
full_description:
At ING we are looking for Data Protection Expert member in DPE Office Team
Your role and work environment:
We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Data Protection Expert to join our dynamic team and help us transform the way we serve our customers.
As part of our team, you’ll play a key role in ensuring that all personal data belonging to our customers and employees is secure and protected, in compliance with relevant policies and regulations (GDPR). We carry out risk assessments to identify and mitigate data protection risks, monitor data transfers, record and track personal data breaches, and add value to the business by ensuring the highest level of privacy and data protection in its contracts and process flows.
Operating in an Agile environment, our mission is simple yet bold:
"Protecting the personal data of our customers and employees, complying with policy and regulations (GDPR)”
Your key responsibilities:
As a Data Protection Expert in the DPE Office Team you will:
1.         Ensure compliance with and implementation of Privacy related regulations at the bank.
2.         Conduct Data Protection related Risk Assessments, for which we work with the business owners to carry out DPIAs (Data Protection Impact Assessments), TIAs (Transfer Impact Assessments), LIAs (Legitimate Interest Assessment),
and record the processing activities in the RoPA (Register of Processing Activities).
3.         Document and manage personal data breaches.
4.         Ensure compliance with the Retention & Deletion policy within the bank.
5.         Monitor third parties, ensuring compliance with these data protection policies by the suppliers we work with.
6.         Design and implement Privacy related Training and Awareness programs across the organization.
7.         Act as a trusted advisor to business units and IT teams, providing guidance on privacy requirements in new products, services, and processes.
8.         Foster a positive and collaborative team environment.
What are we looking for?
Are you the perfect fit? Here’s what we value most:
A proactive attitude:You take on challenges and see them through to success.
A team player:You listen, collaborate, and inspire others to achieve shared goals.
A passionate about a job well done:You have attention to detail and excellence.
A curious learner:You are eager to continue learning about Privacy regulations.
At least 2 years of experience in Data Protection areas.
Eagerness to learn and adapt in a dynamic setting.
Responsibility, decisiveness, and a commitment to quality.
Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 solutions (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint…) and data protection tools.
Valuable: Professional certification or specialization in Data Protection
The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.
Check out what is waiting for you!
Be flexible my friend.
Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing.
So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.
Our house will be your home.
In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!
For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).
We help you protect what matters most to you.
Flexible remuneration.
In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…
Free company shuttle.
It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.
Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!
More vitality and more belonging
360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).
